youtube.aciklama: In the vestibulo-ocular reflex (VOR) x1 exercise, the target is still and only the head moves; the eye must turn in the opposite direction at the same speed as the head, so the required gain is one. In the VOR x2 exercise, the person moves the card in the direction opposite to the head, and the eye must turn at twice the speed of the head; the exercise examples are for education, and each program is planned individually by a qualified clinician.
